sloka: न एव देवी न गन्धर्वी न अप्सरा न च पन्नगी ।तुल्या सीमन्तिनी तस्या मानुषी तु कुतो भवेत् ॥३-३१-३०॥
transliteration: na eva devī na gandharvī na apsarā na ca pannagī ।tulyā sīmantinī tasyā mānuṣī tu kuto bhavet ॥3-31-30॥

translations.english: She has no equal among goddesses nor among gandharvis nor apasaras nor among demonesses. How can there be a peer of her among human beings ?
